basic_info.description: $325,000 price improvement on this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence w/ no shared walls and windows on three sides. Luxury features include kitchens appointed w/ Arclinea Italian cabinetry, Miele appliances & Dornbrach faucets. Wide plank white oak flooring & 9' ceilings. Elegant bathroom w/ slab Carrara marble countertop, free standing tub and shower w/ Carrara marble surrounds, recessed LED lighting w/ dimmers, full size vented washer/dryer. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the home w/ natural light and a 103 sq ft outdoor terrace. Resident enjoy unprecedented amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness studio w/ a monthly calendar of complimentary fitness classes & wellness programming, residents lounge w/ fireplace, rooftop lounge w/ BBQ & expansive views spanning from the Golden Gate to Bay Bridge, staffed front desks, 24/7 roving security. Free shuttle service connects residents to the new ferry dock w/ daily service to the SF Ferry Building free of charge w/ a monthly transportation pass provided to each household. Parking sold separately at $115,000. All images/views are representative.
